title: デビュー戦の後に・賑々しく狂おしき

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki looks pretty exhausted after her debut race. It appears the charged atmosphere added fuel to her competitive spirit, and she had difficulty keeping her emotions in check.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next morning, I spot Yaeno training on her own. She says she's been feeling doubtful about her running since her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask her to confide in me, and it comes out that she's hesitant to burden me with her naturally wild personality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I'm her trainer. I tell her that I accept her, faults and all. Seeing the sincerity in my eyes, she decides to put her faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to run in the Classic Triple Crown tour and select the Mainichi Hai as a race to help prepare for it.
